requirements_summary:
- Use cases: chat support + document search + reranking for results page.
- Latency: p95 <250ms target for interactive chat; <400ms acceptable for rerank calls.
- Throughput: steady ~60-80 QPS, peak up to ~240 QPS during marketing events.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for key material, regional data residency (US-east preferred).
- Contract: prefers 12-month committed Dedicated with monthly billing and upgrade path.
- Integration: already integrated with realtime user session store; needs low tokenization variance across languages.
